query: select l.id as lesson_id, l.title as lesson_title, l.is_active, length(coalesce(l.content, '')) as content_length, s.name as series_name, (select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id = l.id) as exercise_count, (select count(*) from public.exercise_questions eq join public.exercises e on e.id = eq.exercise_id where e.lesson_id = l.id) as exercise_question_count, (select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id = l.id) as quiz_count, (select count(*) from public.quiz_questions qq join public.quizzes q on q.id = qq.quiz_id where q.lesson_id = l.id) as quiz_question_count, (select bool_and(e.is_active = false and e.is_published = false) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id = l.id) as exercises_drafts, (select bool_and(q.is_active = false and q.is_published = false) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id = l.id) as quizzes_drafts from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id = l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id = c.subject_offering_id join public.series s on s.id = o.series_id where l.id in ('b87a86fd-6892-4ca5-9585-4965b1a057bf','5f52ef2e-138e-4ad5-b85b-1df6c416cc23') order by l.id limit 2;
